exercises.question: Which sentence expresses probability?
options: Probablemente habrá más cambios. [There will probably be more changes.]
Habrá más cambios en la sociedad. [There will be more changes in society.]
Hubo más cambios en la sociedad. [There were more changes in society.]

exercises.english: There will probably be new professions.
It is possible that society will be different.

sentences: Primero, probablemente cambiará el trabajo. [First, work will probably change.]
Después, quizá habrá más oportunidades. [Then perhaps there will be more opportunities.]
Finalmente, es posible que la sociedad sea diferente. [Finally, it is possible that society will be different.]

exercises.question: Which word means «to predict»?
options: predecir [to predict]
transformar [to transform]
prepararse [to prepare]

exercises.english: It is possible that there will be more changes.

options: There will probably be more changes.
There were probably more changes.
There will definitely be no changes.

exercises.sentence: Es posible que la sociedad sea diferente.
options: It is possible that society will be different.
Society was certainly different yesterday.
Society cannot change.

exercises.english: Perhaps there will be more opportunities.

options: Probablemente habrá más cambios. [There will probably be more changes.]
Probablemente haberá más cambios. [There will probably be more changes.]
Probablemente hubo más cambios. [There probably were more changes.]
No, es posible que sea diferente. [No, it is possible that it will be different.]
Sí, es seguro que sea diferente. [Yes, it is certain that it is different.]
No, es posible que será diferente. [No, it is possible that it will be different.]
Es probable que haya nuevas profesiones. [It is likely that there will be new professions.]
Es probable que habrá nuevas profesiones. [It is likely that there will be new professions.]
Es probable de que haya nuevas profesiones. [It is likely of that there will be new professions.]

template.prompt: Say that there will probably be new professions.
Say that it is possible that society will be different.
template.answer: Es posible que la sociedad sea diferente.

template.prompt: Say that we cannot know it for sure because the future is uncertain.
template.answer: No podemos saberlo con seguridad porque el futuro es incierto.
